column3: “advanced in years” renders “come into the days.”
“east of Egypt” renders “on the face of Egypt”; NASB puts “it is counted as Canaanite” in parentheses, and “lords” renders “rulers.”
“toward the east” renders “the rising of the sun.”
“With the other half-tribe” renders “with it”; NASB supplies “other half-tribe.”
NASB puts “he alone was left … Rephaim” in parentheses.
“the tribe of Levi” renders “the tribe of the Levites”; “their” is plural for the Hebrew “its.”
“among the rest of their slain” renders “to their slain.”
